$description: The product's STRUCTURE layer above the grid — the app shell, the layout shells (4 route + 2 content), the page-level screen regions, the content layouts, and the panel behaviours. Pairs with layout/grid.json (the 12-col grid that fills these regions). Storybook: Foundations/Layout/*.

appShell.$note: The authenticated app frame — src/views/layouts/main.vue (component `Layout`). Nesting: MLayout(root, flex) > NavBar (left rail) + MLayout.contentContainer > Header (top) + MLayout.main-content-panel > FlotoScrollView > MLayoutContent (the page slot). Plus a global overlay layer.

regions.what: primary icon rail — modules, logo, collapse; see Navigation/PrimaryNav
breadcrumb / back · global search trigger · notifications · user menu
the routed page (the <slot/>); the only scrolling region
global, shell-level, above the content panel

$shellsNote: 4 ROUTE shells (selected by the app.vue switcher: not-logged-in → LoginLayout; else Layout; then route.meta.layout override wins) + 2 CONTENT layouts that render inside Layout. Corrected per foundation/layout-shells.md — MonitorHierarchyLayout has 0 route overrides.

shells.name: Layout
shells.use: every authenticated app page (the DEFAULT — no `layout` route override needed)

shells.name: LoginLayout
shells.chrome: bare — MLayout > MLayoutContent > slot; no socket, no chrome
shells.use: login / reset / forgot-password + disk-full error; also the not-logged-in fallback

shells.name: EmptyLayout
shells.chrome: NO nav, NO header — padded (p-4) scroll content; keeps socket + local-DB
shells.use: full-bleed flow that still needs live data but not the chrome (print-safe report export)
shells.select: Full-screen flow, no nav/header, still authenticated + live.

shells.name: PublicLayout
shells.chrome: like EmptyLayout, full-bleed (-m-4); socket + DB; isMotadataUpdatingOrRestoring
shells.use: public / system pages — upgrade or restore in progress

shells.name: MonitorHierarchyLayout
shells.chrome: a CONTENT layout (renders inside Layout): two-pane — left hierarchy tree (collapsible, affixable, transition-width) + content via MRow/MCol gutter 0
shells.use: monitor / inventory / topology screens with a tree on the left
shells.select: Tree/hierarchy on the left + detail on the right (NOT a route shell).

shells.name: Settings two-pane
shells.chrome: a CONTENT layout (inside Layout): splitpanes — left menu (MCollapse+MMenu, 15%) + RouterView (85%); hidden via meta.hideSettingsMenu

screenRegions.$note: Inside the content panel, a standard page is composed of these regions (top → bottom). Reproduced as the Foundations/Layout/Screen regions story; map to components via index.json.

regions.component: Table · form (MRow/MCol grid) · dashboard grid · detail panes

contentLayouts.name: Single column
contentLayouts.what: header + toolbar + body fill the content panel

contentLayouts.name: Two-pane (tree/menu + content)
contentLayouts.what: left hierarchy/list/menu panel + right detail; left is collapsible/affixable

contentLayouts.name: Master-detail (list + drawer)
contentLayouts.what: list/table + a FlotoDrawer slide-over for the record

contentLayouts.name: Dashboard grid
contentLayouts.what: draggable/resizable widget tiles on a canvas (+ masonry variant)

contentLayouts.name: Chart-over-grid
contentLayouts.what: a fixed chart region above a grid

pageTemplates.$note: The canonical page types (Storybook: Foundations/Layout/Page templates). Full region→component blueprints live in components/recipes/recipes.json — load the recipe id in parens.

templates.name: List view
templates.what: paginated collection: header + toolbar + table + pager

templates.name: Form view
templates.what: create/edit one record on the MRow/MCol grid; often in a drawer

templates.name: Detail view
templates.what: one record: header + status/severity + tabs + panels/charts

templates.name: Graph / Canvas view
templates.what: hierarchy tree + interactive Cytoscape node graph (Topology)

variants: two wizard shapes (multi-route stateful / single-view stepped)

panels.$note: Panel/overlay BEHAVIOURS — how surfaces open/move/resize. Reproduced as the Foundations/Layout/Panel behaviours story. Counts from foundation/panel-behaviours.md.

behaviours.what: right/left overlay for create/edit/detail; ~40% forms, ~90% deep drill-downs; backdrop; ESC to close
centered blocking overlay; confirm/collect; form-in-modal; variant=error for destructive
inline row→detail disclosure (alert stream, log-grid, apm tree-list)
drag-to-resize panes (settings menu+content, topology tree+graph, apm trace)
pin a panel/toolbar/footer on scroll (hierarchy sidebar, wizard footer, time-range)
drag + resize widget grid; masonry variant for varying tile heights
small contextual, non-blocking overlay (menus, column selectors, sub-tabs)
global search / immersive overlay above everything

panels.$notPanel: Table resizable columns (Ant minResizableWidth, 50+ tables) are a GRID feature, not a panel behaviour.
